findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code Injection via eval/exec
 * @description Detecting use of eval or exec which could lead to code injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/code-injection-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 *       external/cwe/cwe-095
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
select call, "Potential code injection via eval, exec or compile."

message.text: Potential code injection via eval, exec or compile.
